#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <iomanip>

using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;

vector<int> convolve(const vector<int>& x, const vector<int>& y, int mod) {
    int m = x.size(), n = y.size();
    int size = 1;
    while (size < m + n - 1) size <<= 1;

    vector<double> xr(size, 0.0), xi(size, 0.0);
    vector<double> yr(size, 0.0), yi(size, 0.0);

    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
        long long v = ((long long)x[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        xr[i] = v & 0x7fff;
        xi[i] = v >> 15;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        long long v = ((long long)y[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        yr[i] = v & 0x7fff;
        yi[i] = v >> 15;
    }

    auto fft = [](vector<double>& re, vector<double>& im, bool inv) {
        int n = re.size();
        int bits = 32 - __builtin_clz(n - 1);
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            int j = __builtin_reversebits((unsigned)i) >> (32 - bits);
            if (i < j) {
                swap(re[i], re[j]);
                swap(im[i], im[j]);
            }
        }

        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
            int half = len >> 1;
            vector<double> cos_table(half);
            vector<double> sin_table(half);
            double angle = 2 * M_PI / len * (inv ? -1 : 1);
            for (int i = 0; i < half; i++) {
                cos_table[i] = cos(i * angle);
                sin_table[i] = sin(i * angle);
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
                for (int j = 0; j < half; j++) {
                    double cr = cos_table[j], ci = sin_table[j];
                    double ur = re[i + j], ui = im[i + j];
                    double vr = re[i + j + half] * cr - im[i + j + half] * ci;
                    double vi = re[i + j + half] * ci + im[i + j + half] * cr;

                    re[i + j] = ur + vr;
                    im[i + j] = ui + vi;
                    re[i + j + half] = ur - vr;
                    im[i + j + half] = ui - vi;
                }
            }
        }

        if (inv) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                re[i] /= n;
                im[i] /= n;
            }
        }
    };

    fft(xr, xi, false);
    fft(yr, yi, false);

    vector<double> resR(size), resI(size);
    vector<double> tmpR(size), tmpI(size);

    double scale = 0.25 / size;
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        int j = (size - i) & (size - 1);

        double a1r = (xr[i] + xr[j]) * 0.5;
        double a1i = (xi[i] - xi[j]) * 0.5;
        double a2r = (xi[i] + xi[j]) * 0.5;
        double a2i = (xr[j] - xr[i]) * 0.5;

        double b1r = (yr[i] + yr[j]) * 0.5;
        double b1i = (yi[i] - yi[j]) * 0.5;
        double b2r = (yi[i] + yi[j]) * 0.5;
        double b2i = (yr[j] - yr[i]) * 0.5;

        resR[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
        resI[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;
        tmpR[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i;
        tmpI[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r;
    }

    fft(resR, resI, true);
    fft(tmpR, tmpI, true);

    int len = m + n - 1;
    vector<int> out(len);
    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        long long p1 = llround(resR[i]);
        long long p2 = llround(tmpR[i]);
        long long p3 = llround(resI[i]);
        out[i] = (int)((p1 + (p2 % MOD << 15) + (p3 % MOD << 30)) % MOD);
    }
    return out;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int MOD = 998244353;
    int n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    
    vector<int> base(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int idx;
        cin >> idx;
        base[idx] = 1;
    }
    
    vector<int> result = {1};
    int exponent = n / 2;
    while (exponent > 0) {
        if (exponent & 1) {
            result = convolve(result, base, MOD);
        }
        base = convolve(base, base, MOD);
        exponent >>= 1;
    }
    
    long long answer = 0;
    for (int val : result) {
        answer = (answer + (long long)val * val) % MOD;
    }
    cout << answer << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
